cohort: 641,941 opioid-naive surgical patients and 18,011,137 opioid-naive nonsurgical patients with private insurance in the United States between 2001 and 2013.
finding: Many surgical procedures are associated with an increased risk of chronic opioid use in the postoperative period among opioid-naive patients.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a 28% increased risk of chronic opioid use compared to nonsurgical patients.
